messages.text: Bingo asymptotics, quiet overcast skies, and the rhythm of the week

Sunday brings a steady, overcast stillness to Canton as the local calendar turns toward mid-month commitments. Science offers a look at the deep geological forces shaping our continents and the quantum mechanics challenging our sense of objective reality.
Expect an overcast day with a high near 55 degrees and a low around 38 degrees.
The sun rises at 7:17 AM and sets at 5:18 PM, with a new moon that is 0.2% illuminated.
A quiet Sunday for inquiry and song

The Math Grad Show and Tell seminar explores the surprising asymptotics of bingo at 3 PM in Ann Arbor's East Hall. Later, The Ark hosts an open stage at 8 PM for those wanting to share music or listen.
A meeting is scheduled for November 11 at 6:30 PM.
Investments in local support and policy

The KeyBank Foundation has invested $250,000 to expand the Shelter Association of Washtenaw County's warming center and resource hub in Ypsilanti. Meanwhile, Congresswoman Debbie Dingell is proposing a Data Center Bill of Rights to address infrastructure and environmental transparency.
